description: Four ghost panels in the corners, each on its own 1-minute schedule with a 50% seeded chance and a different offset, so the ghost pops up somewhere different each minute. The GIF waves once revealed; before that the panel is blank.

panels.title: Boo
panels.description: Schedule: every 1m, show for 20s, offset 0s, 50% chance per cycle. The GIF only animates once revealed.

panels.title: Boo!
panels.description: Schedule: every 1m, show for 20s, offset 20s, 50% chance per cycle. The GIF only animates once revealed.

panels.title: Boo?
panels.description: Schedule: every 1m, show for 20s, offset 40s, 50% chance per cycle. The GIF only animates once revealed.

panels.title: ...boo
panels.description: Schedule: every 1m, show for 20s, offset 10s, 50% chance per cycle. The GIF only animates once revealed.
